scope: Seven complete SQL/database files; 210 distinct cases, separately executed in ordinary and secure modes.

pgvector_blocker.documented_windows_requirements: Visual Studio C++ support and x64 Native Tools nmake build

earlier_attempts.label: remaining-database-ordinary-01
earlier_attempts.outcome: Fixture setup stopped before tests: MariaDB has no shared_memory system variable. Native server shut down safely.

earlier_attempts.label: remaining-database-ordinary-02
failures: SQLite public tool leaked QueryDeadlineExceeded from __enter__

First MySQL call returned ERROR without cancellation binding (unsupported), at 0.59 seconds; consistent with cold initialization consuming the 300 ms admission budget, but the original error string was not separately captured

earlier_attempts.label: remaining-database-observed-03
earlier_attempts.outcome: Observational helper forgot to yield for non-MySQL cases; fixed only the external observer. All three native MySQL cases passed.

earlier_attempts.label: remaining-database-observed-04
earlier_attempts.outcome: Unmodified baseline with corrected observational hooks; real slow statements, KILL QUERY and server-only timeout were observed.
Deterministic read/write expired-admission regressions fail at the public tool boundary before the repair.
The identical two regressions pass after the product repair.

earlier_attempts.label: remaining-database-final-ordinary-01
earlier_attempts.outcome: New halt regression omitted required source constructor argument; follow-up c30affc corrected the fixture only.

limits: Portable MariaDB 11.4.8 Windows qualification does not claim MySQL Server or Linux coverage.
pgvector extension remains unavailable without missing MSVC C++/nmake and Windows SDK.
No production, remote database, live provider, host service, or deployment credential actions.
No fresh full 580-case PostgreSQL rerun is claimed; the earlier ledger remains historical evidence.
